about: Real CDC notices from 7-21 Nov 2026 (other students' names, rolls and phone numbers removed). Expected answers were written by reading each notice, not by running Ping. The 15 notices marked held_out were labelled after Ping had been fixed on the others, and were never used to change Ping: they show how it does on notices it wasn't tuned for.

notices.subject: Shortlist
notices.text: Please find attached the list of eligible candidates for the in-campus coding assessment for the Accenture India Elite Technology Engineer FTE role. The slot timing and reporting room for each candidate are given in the attached list.Date: 31st October 2026Slot Timing and Reporting Room: As per the attached listNote: Students are requested to report to the venue 15 minutes before their slot time. The test will begin promptly at the scheduled time.Important Instructions: - MacBooks are strictly not allowed for this test.It is mandatory for all students to carry the following items to be eligible for the in-campus assessment: - A printout of the admit card sent to the registered email ID. A soft copy of the admit card will not be considered valid. - Original physical PAN card with photo. Scanned copies, photocopies, or laminated copies of the PAN card will not be accepted. DigiLocker PAN cards will not be considered valid. - If a student does not have their physical PAN card, they can download the official E-PAN card from an official source and bring a printed copy of it. - PAN cards made when the candidate was a minor will not be accepted, and such candidates will be rejected. - A PAN application acknowledgment will not be treated as valid proof.Laptop Requirements: - Operating system: Windows 11 - RAM: 8 GB or more - Processor: Intel i3 8th Generation 2.2 GHz or higher - Browser: Latest 3 versions of Google Chrome - Webcam and microphone must work and stay on during the test. The webcam must show a clear image. - Uninstall any VPN and proxy setups.Safe Exam Browser (SEB): - Uninstall any old version of Safe Exam Browser, then install the new version from this link: https://securetest.hirepro.in/accenture/v2/POC: [contact removed], [contact removed]CDC, IIT Kharagpur
